title: Measured usage event contract, imports and phase reports
goal: Make observed development token spend attributable without fabricating counts or changing work priority
acceptance: Define versioned repository/item/task/job/attempt/phase events with actual provider usage and source provenance; unavailable values remain null
Idempotent imports and explicit shared allocations conserve provider totals across items; retries and failures remain visible
Report input/output and cached/reasoning subsets correctly; optional cost retains currency/pricing provenance or stays unknown
Show known-spend totals, source coverage/unallocated usage and phase splits separately from remaining-budget estimates
Provide optional batch-planning advice without changing priority, dependencies, authority, human acceptance or budget permissions
Use private local data and neutral fixtures; no prompts, credentials, identity or conversation scraping
privacy: Only explicitly supplied usage metadata or authorized runner/provider outputs; never prompts, secrets or personal session text. No model calls needed for fixtures.
validation: Neutral source fixtures cover missing metrics, cached subsets, duplicate/replayed events, retries, shared allocations and incomplete totals
Template/owned tool tests and fresh-context review before release; no downstream adoption or model campaign required
escalation: Missing usage source means unknown, not invented totals
New privacy permissions, source authentication or authority changes require review; no automatic cloud fallback
